What I like most about Gu teppanyaki
Sep 2026 • Friends
I have eaten at quite a few fine dining restaurants in Saigon and Hanoi, so I'm often not too impressed by places that are just beautiful, luxurious, or use expensive ingredients.

What I like most about Gu is the way the chef makes the dishes quite restrained, handling the ingredients correctly, rather than adding too much sauce or seasoning. Seafood retains its sweetness, the meat retains the deliciousness of the ingredients, but it becomes more fragrant and flavorful after cooking.

Another thing I like is the service here. Not overly formal or pretentious, everything is just right, extremely subtle and intimate. The pace of eating is also comfortable, not afraid of the feeling of having to eat quickly to keep up with each dish.

So I think if people who are used to fine dining and want to try a different experience, Gu is quite worth trying. I personally like how the restaurant focuses on ingredient quality and technique rather than trying to make everything overly complicated.

One of the Best Omakase Experiences in Ho Chi Minh City
Aug 2026 • Family
One of the best Omakase Teppanyaki experiences in Ho Chi Minh City.

The biggest highlight of my visit was having the chance to try Hachinomi (Bluefin Tuna Head Meat) for the very first time. It’s one of the rarest and most prized cuts of bluefin tuna. The texture was incredibly delicate, almost buttery, with a clean, rich flavor that melted in my mouth without feeling heavy or greasy. It was truly an unforgettable culinary experience.

The Omakase set also featured premium ingredients, including live Boston lobster, Japanese A5 Wagyu, and King Crab. Every dish was prepared right in front of us on the teppanyaki grill by the chef, whose precision, timing, and cooking techniques made each course both delicious and entertaining. It felt more like a live culinary performance than just a meal.

The restaurant offers a warm, elegant atmosphere with impeccable service from beginning to end. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion, planning a romantic dinner, or entertaining business guests, this is definitely a place worth visiting.

Highly recommended, and I’ll definitely be back. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
